title: Breece Hall has "positive jealousy" about the Knicks winning the NBA title

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Breece Hall has "positive jealousy" about the Knicks winning the NBA title
sources.description: Running back Breece Hall is in New Jersey for the Jets' minicamp this week, but he took some time out of preparing for the 2026 season by taking a trip to San Antonio for Game 5 of the NBA Finals last weekend.
